posts.author: Jeffrey
posts.content_md:
[http://www.bryantlaboratory.com/photographic.html](http://www.bryantlaboratory.com/photographic.html)

I love these guys. I used to just drive over there, in Berkeley. They ship anywhere.

Their web page is taking forever to get together, probably hired the wrong web designers to get them online after 80 years of over-the-counter service, but you can FAX an order in, or call.

I always liked their prices so much, I haven't compared in a long time. Let me know...
